keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «지구 온난화의 대부분은 사람이 석탄, 석유, 가스를 태우면서 생긴다(원인)» 과 «2100년의 지구는 앞으로 수십 년 동안 사람들이 하는 선택에 크게 달려 있다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the cause (most of the warming is caused by humans burning coal, oil, and gas) and the conclusion (Earth in 2100 will depend largely on the choices people make in the coming decades). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Possible climates of Earth in the year 2100

boxes.qen: What are the two possible futures?
boxes.a: About 4 degrees of warming with high emissions, or 1.5 to 2 with low emissions
Cheaper solar and wind power, electric vehicles, and protecting forests

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: Since the late 1800s, Earth has warmed by about 1.1 degrees Celsius, mostly because humans burn coal, oil, and

qs.q: Why has Earth's average temperature risen since the late 1800s?
qs.qko: 1800년대 후반부터 지구의 평균 기온은 왜 올랐나요?
opts: Because the Sun has become much brighter
Because humans burn coal, oil, and gas, which release greenhouse gases
Because forests produce too much oxygen
evs: Solar and wind power have become much cheaper over the past decade, and electric vehicles are spreading in many countries.
Most of this warming is caused by humans burning coal, oil, and gas, which releases carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
No one can predict the future exactly, but climate scientists can describe possible paths.
This could bring stronger heat waves, rising sea levels, and serious problems for farming and water supplies.
why: 기온 상승의 대부분은 사람이 석탄, 석유, 가스를 태우면서 이산화탄소 같은 온실가스를 내뿜기 때문이에요.
Most of the warming is caused by humans burning coal, oil, and gas, which releases greenhouse gases.

qs.q: In the last sentence, what does 'writing it' mean?
qs.qko: 마지막 문장에서 'writing it(그것을 쓰는 것)' 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: Helping to decide Earth's future through our choices
Writing a science report about the climate
Reading more stories about the year 2100
evs: The Earth of 2100 has not already been decided.
Since the late 1800s, the average temperature of Earth's surface has risen by about 1.1 degrees Celsius.
It will depend largely on the choices people make in the coming decades.
In a high-emission scenario, where fossil fuel use keeps rising, global temperatures could rise by about 4 degrees or more by 2100.
why: 2100년의 지구는 아직 정해지지 않았고, 앞으로 수십 년 동안의 선택에 크게 달려 있다고 했어요. 그러니 «이야기를 쓴다» 는 것은 우리의 선택으로 미래를 만든다는 뜻이에요.
Earth in 2100 has not been decided and depends on the choices of the coming decades. So 'writing it' means shaping the future through our choices.

qs.q: Why does the writer say the difference between the two futures is enormous?
qs.qko: 글쓴이는 왜 두 미래의 차이가 엄청나다고 말하나요?
opts: Both futures would bring exactly the same temperature
Neither future depends on human choices
One path could mean about 4 degrees of warming, the other only about 1.5 to 2
evs: In a high-emission scenario, where fossil fuel use keeps rising, global temperatures could rise by about 4 degrees or more by 2100.
These gases trap heat in the atmosphere, much like a blanket.
In a low-emission scenario, where the world quickly reduces greenhouse gases, warming could be kept close to 1.5 to 2 degrees.
Solar and wind power have become much cheaper over the past decade, and electric vehicles are spreading in many countries.
why: 온실가스 배출이 계속 늘면 2100년까지 약 4도 이상 오를 수 있지만, 빠르게 줄이면 1.5~2도 가까이로 막을 수 있어요. 두 문장을 비교해야 차이가 보여요.
High emissions could mean about 4 degrees or more, while quickly cutting emissions could keep warming near 1.5 to 2 degrees. Compare the two sentences.

ends: How can a school cut its energy use?
학교는 어떻게 에너지 사용을 줄일 수 있을까?
What will coastal cities look like if sea levels rise?
해수면이 높아지면 바닷가 도시는 어떤 모습이 될까?

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «어떤 조건 + 그때 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own condition and what we can do in English.
write.src: “If <u>more families switch to solar power</u>, we can <u>cut the greenhouse gases we release</u>.”

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «If» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 하면» 을, «we can» 뒤에는 동사원형을 넣어 보세요. (예: If our school recycles paper, we can save many trees)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «If», write who + what; after «we can», start with a base verb. (e.g. If our school recycles paper, we can save many trees)
